notes:
New Features:

+ Adds automatic fresh stream re-resolve recovery for .com, .click, FuckFlix, OXAX and Guljaj when an active HLS manifest is confirmed stuck, ended or repeatedly unreachable.

+ Recovery is bounded to three automatic switches per channel within a 20-minute diagnostic chain and never restarts playback after a manual stop.

Improvements:

+ HLS diagnostics now run as reliable one-shot samples every 30 seconds; each completed sample schedules the next instead of relying on Kodi AlarmClock loop mode.

+ Auto-recovery requests a completely fresh Site/PVR resolver URL while leaving normal playback untouched until a stuck-feed condition is confirmed.

Bugfixes:

- Fixes v1.112 diagnostics stopping after the first manifest sample on affected Kodi/LibreELEC builds.
